cases.question: Under this policy, will I pay a withdrawal charge?

response.message: Yes, a withdrawal charge applies to each cash withdrawal you make from the policy [1][2]. The current charge is US$25 / HK$200 / MOP200 per withdrawal [1][2]. The withdrawal charge is waived if you use the automatic periodic withdrawal option [1]. That option is only available once the policy has been in force for at least 10 years [2]. This is separate from the surrender charge, which applies in the first 14 years from the Policy Date or from the effective date of each increase in Basic Sum Insured if the policy lapses, is surrendered, or the Basic Sum Insured is decreased [1]. The surrender charge rate depends on the insured's gender, issue age, smoking habit, risk class, and years in effect [1].

Current requirement on minimum monthly withdrawal amount is US$500/HK$/MOP4,000, with minimum withdrawal period of one year; and the minimum annual withdrawal amount is US$6,000/HK$48,000/ MOP48,000, with minimum withdrawal period of three years. For any change after the application has been confirmed, a nominal fee will be levied.
7. The current charge for each withdrawal is US$25/HK$ 200/MOP200.
8. Unemployment Protection is only applicable to the Basic Plan.
